meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 会接入 Resend 邮件频道：复制适配器、注册、安装依赖并构建验证；引导你完成 Resend 账户、域名、API 密钥和 webhook 配置并写入 .env；把你的邮箱设为所有者并发送欢迎邮件，即可用邮件异步对话。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Resend 邮件频道、接入电子邮件，或要求配置 NanoClaw 的邮件收发时触发。

say.text: 帮我加上 Resend 邮件频道
say.note: 技能会复制适配器并开始配置。

say.text: 用 Resend 接邮件，我的邮箱是 me@example.com
say.note: 会把你设为所有者并发测试邮件。

say.text: 配置好 Resend 后给我发个测试邮件
say.note: 技能会完成配置并发送 hello。

howto.what_en: Adds Resend email to NanoClaw: copies adapter, registers, installs pinned dependency, builds/tests, guides you through Resend account/domain/API/webhook setup, saves credentials to .env, wires your address as owner, and sends a welcome email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Resend email channel, connect email, or configure NanoClaw's email send/receive.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter and starts setup.

say_en.text: Set up NanoClaw with Resend; my email is me@example.com.
say_en.note: Wires you as owner and emails hello.

say_en.text: Configure Resend, then send me a test email.
